technologies.description: Redis is an in-memory data structure store, used as a distributed, in-memory key–value database, cache and message broker, with optional durability. Redis supports different kinds of abstract data structures, such as strings, lists, maps, sets, sorted sets, HyperLogLogs, bitmaps, streams, and spatial indices.
technologies.name: Redis

technologies.description: Keycloak is an open source identity and access management solution that makes it easy to secure applications and services with very little coding. It provides a single sign-on and identity management solution for applications and services, and supports a wide range of authentication protocols, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, and LDAP. Keycloak also provides a comprehensive user management system, allowing administrators to easily manage users, roles, and permissions.
technologies.name: Keycloak
